body.html: What sets Good Nakhonsawan Hotel apart from many hotels in Nakhon Sawan is that it's genuinely new, having opened in 2024. The rooms, furniture and bathrooms are still in fresh condition, which is what guests praise most. The hotel sits on Highway 225, about 800 m from the Bueng Boraphet intersection, and you can drive into central Pak Nam Pho in about 10 minutes — a location that puts you close to Bueng Boraphet without being far from town.

What earns the high scores is the outdoor pool, rooftop pool and pool villas with a private pool — amenities you don't often find at this price point around Nakhon Sawan. There's a children's pool and a playground too, which makes it popular with families driving through who want the kids to cool off after a long stretch in the car. Free breakfast is served Thai-and-Western style, with free parking and free Wi-Fi — enough for a night or two on the road.

Rooms come in several types, from Deluxe Double and Deluxe King at around 25 sq.m., to a Junior Suite with a bathtub, up to a four-bedroom pool villa with a private pool at 252 sq.m. that sleeps up to 8 — ideal for a group of friends or a large family. Every room is air-conditioned with a streaming TV, fridge, water heater, work desk and a self-service refreshments corner. Plenty of reviews mention the spacious bathrooms and comfortable beds.
"Very new and clean, with soundproofing so good you barely hear anything outside. Lots of breakfast options, friendly staff, and good value for money."

Something guests mention again and again is the better-than-expected soundproofing. Many say they slept well despite the hotel being on a highway, because the rooms hold sound well. Combined with the spotless feel of a new property and friendly staff, the overall Trip.com score sits as high as around 9.3 out of 10 — very high for a hotel in Nakhon Sawan province.

To be honest, what reviews flag is the price being higher than the older hotels in town. Some feel it's a touch pricey given that Nakhon Sawan isn't a major tourist destination. Breakfast is seen as fine but not special, and the hotel leans on being new and functional rather than having much character of its own. A few reviews mention unclear front-desk communication about extra charges for children, so it's worth confirming at booking.

Overall, Good Nakhonsawan Hotel scores around 9.3/10 on Trip.com (300+ reviews), which is high among Nakhon Sawan hotels. It's a great fit for families or drivers passing through who want fresh, clean rooms, a pool the kids can use, and a spot near Bueng Boraphet. Prices start around ฿1,200 for a Deluxe, climb into the mid-thousands for a Junior Suite, and reach five figures for the pool villa — if you'll pay a little more for newness and a pool, it delivers.

A tip from reading the reviews: if you're travelling as a group or a large family, look at the pool villa with its private pool — split between you, it's better value than you'd think. For a one-night stopover, a Deluxe is plenty. Want a bathtub? Choose the Junior Suite. And if you're travelling with kids, confirm the extra charges and kids' breakfast at booking so there are no surprises at checkout.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Good Nakhonsawan Hotel, Nakhon Sawan

faq.q: Where is Good Nakhonsawan Hotel, and is it near Bueng Boraphet?
faq.a: Good Nakhonsawan Hotel is at 150/1 Moo 4, Highway 225, Pak Nam Pho, about 800 m from the Bueng Boraphet intersection. It's about a 5-minute drive to Bueng Boraphet Beach and around 10 minutes into central Pak Nam Pho — close to the lake but not far from town.

faq.q: How much does Good Nakhonsawan Hotel cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at around ฿1,200/night for a Deluxe room of about 25 sq.m. Options range from Deluxe to a Junior Suite with a bathtub, a Family Room, and a four-bedroom pool villa with a private pool. Always compare across platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Good Nakhonsawan Hotel have a swimming pool?
faq.a: Yes — there's an outdoor pool, a rooftop pool and a children's pool, plus a playground. There are also pool villas with a private pool for groups or large families. It's a big reason families driving through like to stay here.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at Good Nakhonsawan Hotel — are they really new?
faq.a: It's a hotel that opened in 2024, so the rooms, furniture and bathrooms are still fresh, clean and well soundproofed. They come with a streaming TV, fridge, water heater, work desk and a self-service refreshments corner. This is what guests praise most in reviews.

faq.q: Who is Good Nakhonsawan Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's best for families and drivers passing through who want fresh, clean rooms, a pool the kids can use, and a spot near Bueng Boraphet. It's less suited to travellers on a very tight budget, since it costs more than the older hotels in town.

faq.q: Is Good Nakhonsawan Hotel pet-friendly, and is breakfast included?
faq.a: It is pet-friendly (around ฿300 per pet per night). Free breakfast is served Thai-and-Western style from 7:00 to 10:00 AM. Reviews see the breakfast as fine but not special. Parking and Wi-Fi are free.
